name: @pullfm/load
description: Pull.fm scalability suite: k6 scenarios plus a mock upstream layer. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.smoke: pnpm results:dir && SMOKE=1 DURATION=30s RAMP_UP=5s RAMP_DOWN=5s ARRIVAL_RATE=2 k6 run scenarios/steady-10k.js
scripts.inspect: for f in scenarios/*.js; do printf '%-24s' "$(basename $f)"; k6 inspect -e I_UNDERSTAND_BURST_50K_IS_DEFERRED=1 "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; echo 'parses'; done
